title: Coding tasks, hidden tests and deterministic grader
goal: Coding tasks, hidden tests and deterministic grader
acceptance: examples/coding-v1.json: coding-layer cases on a registered runner, area coding, regression and holdout splits, Python and TypeScript
Each task has a prompt, a starter file and input/expected cases kept apart from what the candidate sees

Grading is out of process: the candidate's process gets only the candidate, a driver and the inputs; the grader outside compares returned values with expectations it alone holds and bounds its own wait

Tampering candidates (framework patching, assertion overwrite, summary forgery, early exit) fail; trusted reference and seeded-wrong candidates prove the grader in CI; no model and no untrusted code run
Index entry and test-index regenerated; the pack says its public holdouts are contamination-exposed
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Failing pack test first; fixture for each acceptance item; npm test; npm run check:index; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Merged in PR #86 on green CI (run 45506501552) on 2026-11-25 after two design reviews; redesigned to out-of-process grading. No actual: elapsed time not measured by work-usage.
